text: Hey all, quick question—does anyone have the details for 'GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd > Medical Insurance'? Got a new hire asking about coverage and how to access specialist care.

Yep, I can help! Singapore team members are covered under HSBC Insurance, it’s pretty comprehensive. Hospital, surgical, major medical, maternity, outpatient GP and specialist, plus dental are all included.

For specialist care, first check if the doctor’s in the IHP Panel Clinics Directory (there’s a Google Drive link in the handbook, let me know if you need it). If they’re on the panel, call IHP at +64 6715 9422 before your appointment for cashless. If not, get a memo from the specialist and submit it with your claim through the IHP portal.

You can do most stuff—claims, teleconsults, finding clinics, etc.—through the IHP Portal. There’s a guide in the handbook, slide 49 has info on Letters of Guarantee if you need one for hospital admission.
Super helpful, thanks Elena! I’ll pass this on to my new joiner too.
